svg.font-family: Nunito, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Self-attention weights from the token “it”
svg.desc: The sentence "The cat sat because it was tired" with the word "it" attending to every other word. The line to "cat" is thickest, with 62% of the attention weight, which is how the model resolves what "it" refers to.

g.text: Line thickness shows how much attention “it” pays to each word.
